rachel: heads-up: hit a weird redaction/flakiness in the .NET sample app. When we flip log level at runtime the console formatter sometimes prints raw request IDs during retry windows but the structured sink always redacts. repro below.

rachel: ```
1) launch samples/dotnet-telemetry with LOG_LEVEL=Information + OTEL hook
2) call admin api to set log level to Debug at runtime
3) trigger downstream 503 -> client retries (RetryPolicy with async delay)
4) occasionally see: Console: 'Retry attempt 2 for req=rid-99' while structured JSON shows "req": null
```

ben: interesting. which logger + formatter? Serilog with Console + File sinks; we use a RedactionEnricher that strips metadata.

rachel: exact lines from stdout: `warn: DownstreamClient[0] Retry attempt 2 for req=rid-99` and later structured file: `{"ts":"...","level":"Warning","req":null}`

yusuf: two hypotheses: 1) RedactionEnricher runs when event created but our retry helper writes inline token into the message string (same as other sdks). 2) Formatter pipeline swap on runtime level change detaches the enricher from console sink.

ben: also seeing test flakiness in CI: tests that assert no raw reqId in stdout fail intermittently. Could be timing (retry occurs during config swap).

rachel: code snippet from retry helper: `Log.Warning($"Retry attempt {i} for req={ctx.ReqId}");` — that embeds id in message string. Should be `Log.Warning("Retry attempt {Attempt}", i, new { req = ctx.ReqId });` or use structured template with property.

yusuf: quick fix: update samples to use structured templates and add a small integration test that flips log level while forcing immediate retry to reproduce. Longer term: consider moving redaction to a Serilog sink-level filter that runs after formatting as last-resort (but perf cost).

ci-bot: created draft PR: samples/dotnet-telemetry#12 - change retry logs to structured props + add flaky integration test. CI will run matrix.

ops-bot: Incident INC-5064 created: dotnet-console-redact-flaky - assignee: devex-oncall.

ben: parity note: python/go already handle inline message redaction and .NET is currently out-of-parity. marking sdk-parity + telemetry.

rachel: added a small note to onboarding doc: "Do not embed sensitive ids in raw message strings; pass as structured properties." Will follow-up after PR merges. :+1:
